title: Private House Design 217 m², Kyiv | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 217 m² private house in Kyiv: interior design, 3D visualization, technical drawings, custom furniture and turnkey renovation.
h1: Interior design of a private house in Kyiv, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 217 m²

blocks.text: Interior design of a private house in Kyiv, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 217 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN designed and delivered a project for a 217 m² private house in Kyiv, Ukraine: interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture, and a turnkey renovation. The project included the living room, bedrooms, kitchen with built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, and bathrooms; the kitchen, wardrobes, walk-in closets, and storage systems were custom-made to the dimensions of the rooms. Before work began, the client received a detailed cost estimate for labor, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, and lighting; the studio then carried out a turnkey renovation of the house and installed the furniture. The gallery features 3D visualizations of the project.
